name: Bloodmage Slaughterhouse Offering shows as a buff and can be cancelled (#8098)
contract: #8098: Slaughterhouse Offering 1108493 lands on the ally as a debuff that cannot be right-clicked off. Cause: effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN (14, +damage taken from spells, the 'offering' cost) so SpellMgr::LoadSpellInfoCustomAttributes auto-marks SPELL_ATTR0_CU_NEGATIVE_EFF0; effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING (115, +healing taken, the payoff). Any marked effect makes SpellInfo::IsPositive false, so the client renders a debuff and WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode refuses CMSG_CANCEL_AURA. The description addresses 'the targeted party member', so the aura is an ally buff with a drawback, not a debuff. Fix: bloodmage_talent_contracts clears SPELL_ATTR0_CU_NEGATIVE for all three ranks (1108459/1108463/1108493), keeping both effects. Rank 1 is the probe: identical effect shape across ranks, max rank covered by in-game testing. Fails pre-fix at the cancel (aura stays 1).
